sentences.text: IPMA forecasts a 100% chance of rain today, 2026-11-21, at Faro, Portimão, Loulé and Sagres.
Faro today has a minimum of 13.2 °C and a maximum of 20.7 °C, with moderate south-westerly wind.
Tomorrow, 2026-11-22, the chance of rain is 0% at Faro, Portimão, Loulé and Sagres.
Sagres tomorrow has a minimum of 9.5 °C and a maximum of 18.4 °C, with moderate northerly wind.
IPMA lists no active warning for the Faro district.

On 2026-11-22, IPMA expects waves of 1.9 to 2.1 metres from the north-west on the Sagres coast, with sea temperatures of 18.4 to 18.6 °C, and waves of 0.8 to 1.2 metres from the west on the Faro coast, with sea temperatures of 18.2 to 18.6 °C.
